mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_applications ja WHERE ja.agency_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT ja.id, ja.job_demand_id, jd.title AS jobTitle, c.name AS jobCountry, jd.city AS jobCity, ja.agency_id, a.full_name AS agencyName, a.email AS agencyEmail, ja.candidate_id, CONCAT(cand.first_name, ' ', cand.last_name) AS candidateName, cand.trade AS candidateTrade, cand.passport_number AS candidatePassportNumber, cand.candidate_type AS candidateType, ja.notes, ja.status, TO_CHAR(ja.applied_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS appliedAt, ja.rejection_reason, ja.reviewed_by AS reviewedBy, TO_CHAR(ja.reviewed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reviewedAt, ja.created_at AS createdAt, ja.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM job_applications ja INNER JOIN job_demands jd ON ja.job_demand_id = jd.id LEFT JOIN countries c ON jd.country_id = c.id LEFT JOIN users a ON ja.agency_id = a.id INNER JOIN candidates cand ON ja.candidate_id = cand.id WHERE ja.agency_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ja.applied_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_applications ja WHERE ja.agency_id IS NULL

SELECT ja.id, ja.job_demand_id, jd.title AS jobTitle, c.name AS country, jd.city AS city, jd.salary_amount, jd.salary_currency, ja.candidate_id, CONCAT(cand.first_name, ' ', cand.last_name) AS candidateName, cand.trade AS candidateTrade, ja.notes, ja.status, TO_CHAR(ja.applied_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS appliedAt, ja.rejection_reason, ja.created_at AS createdAt, ja.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM job_applications ja INNER JOIN job_demands jd ON ja.job_demand_id = jd.id LEFT JOIN countries c ON jd.country_id = c.id INNER JOIN candidates cand ON ja.candidate_id = cand.id WHERE ja.agency_id IS NULL
ORDER BY ja.applied_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
